integrity: The primary source was inspected at its finite point blow-up theorem, one-point smooth-type and Chern-class calculation, tangent-cohomology and automorphism result, and base-family biholomorphism classification. The new step proves intrinsic uniqueness of the exceptional divisor from its Chern class and negative normal bundle, then descends any blow-up biholomorphism to the pointed bases. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies one-point blow-ups only. It identifies their biholomorphism classes with automorphism orbits but does not explicitly parameterize those orbits, and it does not claim deformation inequivalence.
title: Point-orbit rigidity for exotic Oka complex structures on projective three-space
